synopsis: Chapter 11 and the glossary consistently place the NI PXIe-8842 controller at approximately USD 5,200 [f8644, f9227, f16035, f16147]. This is a controller-only price, not the cost of a complete test bench or HIL bench [f8644, f16035]. A broader NI VeriStand/PXI/CompactRIO system requires a quote, so the controller listing does not establish the total system budget [f9227].
